status: exploratory probe of whether multi-step decision has value; not a benchmark reproduction and not a claim about any published method

setting.source: Chen et al., IJCAI 2023, basic deterministic comparison

cost_unit: sigma evaluations (cascade queries); degree spends 0 to decide

decision_rule.search_gains_and_dqn_gains: combinatorial decision has room; next ask whether a learned policy can cut cost
decision_rule.search_gains_dqn_does_not: fix RL representation and training first; do not add a surrogate to mask the cause
decision_rule.neither_gains: do not scale up; these settings give no basis for further investment

dqn_protocol.selection: best validation checkpoint, as in the paper's protocol
dqn_protocol.reporting: ALL seeds reported, plus mean/median, plus what best-of-N would have claimed

degree.note: no cascade query is used to choose; degrees are read directly

no_action_masking.note: best validation normalized influence with the fix reverted

bootstrap_at_terminal.note: best validation normalized influence with the fix reverted
